newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran wants $25 mln damages from Sarnafil.
newsitem.headline: Iran wants $25 mln damages from Sarnafil.

text.p: Iran has asked Swiss construction firm Sarnafil for $25 million in compensation after a huge tent built by the company was damaged by a storm last week, a senior official said in remarks published on Tuesday.
Sarnafil is part of Sarna Kunststoff Holding AG.

Nasser Vaez Tabasi, head of Sarakhs Free Trade Zone, said the demand was based on alleged miscalculations by Sarnafil in building the tent which led to serious damage in the storm on Thursday, the daily Akhbar said.

The tent, with an area of 18,000 sq meters (194,000 sq feet), had cost 3.5 million Swiss francs ($2.3 million) to set up and was to be the centre of a development project in the free trade zone on the border with Turkmenistan, the newspaper added.
The tent was the site of ceremonies attended by several regional heads of state last year to inaugurate a rail link between Iran and its Central Asian neighbour Turkmenistan.
